facts.note: Girard says he would not show the master his watch at dinner, then sat alone in the dining room with brandy, heard the temple strike ten there, and says he did not look at his watch.
He went out to smoke at twenty-one minutes past ten by his watch and stayed under the front windows of the house.
The piano started in the salon just as he lit his cigar, at twenty-nine minutes past ten by his watch.
At twenty-six minutes to eleven by his watch he heard faint quick bells from the master's window up above. Same reading as 10:34.
He came back in at fourteen minutes to eleven by his watch; the hall clock had just struck eleven and its face showed two minutes past eleven; he went straight up to Félix in the library.
